parameters.jsCode: return { json: { ...$('Normalize and Validate').item.json, status: 'draft_created', success: true, draftId: String($json.id ?? $json.draftId ?? ''), failureCode: '' } };

return { json: { ...$('Normalize and Validate').item.json, status: 'provider_failed', success: false, failureCode: 'provider_error', failureMessage: String($json.error?.message ?? $json.message ?? 'Provider execution failed').slice(0, 500) } };
return { json: { ...$json, status: 'draft_content_failed', success: false, failureCode: $json.outputErrors.join(',') } };

return { json: { ...$('Normalize and Validate').item.json, status: 'draft_create_failed', success: false, failureCode: 'gmail_draft_error', failureMessage: String($json.error?.message ?? $json.message ?? 'Draft creation failed').slice(0, 500) } };
